OpenAI launches new voice AI models for natural conversation

OpenAI has announced the launch of two new voice AI models, GPT-Live-1 and GPT-Live-1 mini. These models are designed to improve live conversations by enabling more natural interaction. The company stated that ChatGPT will now be able to converse in a more natural manner.
